rules.description: Arabic: < key types ذ (Shift layer unchanged)
Caps Lock: hold = Hyper (cmd+ctrl+opt+shift, Raycast hotkeys), tap (< 200 ms) = Caps Lock
Right Command: hold + key = F12 then key (herdr prefix layer, only keys herdr binds)
Swap ^ and < (inkl. Shift-Varianten) nur auf interner Tastatur
